rationale: itnet_v2-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=30, batch_size=1, val_chunk=1, grad_clip=2.0, seed=42, pretrain_epochs=72, pretrain_lr=0.001, pretrain_patience=5, itnet_k=1, unet_c=24, residual_learning=False, rationale=iter-10: KNOB=grad_clip 1.0->2.0 (single change; CEILING-CONFIRMATION probe -- the MODEL config is otherwise FROZEN at iter-8/9: KEEP pretrain_epochs=72, itnet_k=1, residual_learning=False, pretrain_lr=1e-3, train_n=200, val_n=30, unet_c=24, seed=42). PRIOR RESULT: iter-9 widened val_n 8->30 for a clean read and landed val_score=0.9630 (val_psnr 40.63 dB, hr 0.410) -- confirming the ~0.965 CONFIG CEILING of the fresh restart's k=1 recipe (the prior run's 0.9714 is NOT reachable here). The epochs lever is saturated at k=1 (iter-6 ep40=0.9648, iter-7 ep56=0.9608, iter-8 ep72=0.9646, iter-9 ep72/val30=0.9630, all <=0.9648). The campaign record already rules OUT every MODEL capacity/data/init knob on this axis (unet_c=32 / train_n=300 / seed / lr-0.6x ALL worse on the prior run). FAILURE MODE / what's untried: grad_clip has been PINNED at 1.0 for all 9 fresh-run iters and is the only optimisation-dynamics axis never probed in this run. With ep72/k=1 and the 2304-view FBP adjoint, a clip of 1.0 may be truncating legitimate residual-denoiser gradient updates and capping the fit just shy of the ceiling. DEFINITIVE TEST: loosen grad_clip 1.0->2.0 (let larger updates through) on the frozen ep72/k=1/val30 config for a clean low-variance read. HYPOTHESIS (ceiling-documentation): itnet_v2 is at its ~0.965 config ceiling and the grad_clip read lands ~0.965 +/- noise -- if so it documents that the ceiling is NOT a gradient-clipping artefact (rules out the last optimisation-dynamics axis), and iters 11-20 continue documenting the ceiling on the remaining untried axes (batch_size, val_chunk, small train_n bump). A small lift toward ~0.971 would instead reopen the optimisation-dynamics direction. WALL GUARD: grad_clip is free (no extra compute); ep72/k=1 ran ~260-270s at val_n=30 (iter-9) -- well under the 15-min cap.
